about: House recipes, batch 04 (helper sA): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Roast Vegetable Barley Bowl with Feta and Lemon Tahini
recipes.summary: A warm Mediterranean grain bowl of pearl barley, roasted zucchini, capsicum and chickpeas with feta.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Roast the zucchini, capsicum and chickpeas with the oil for 25 minutes until charred at the edges.
Simmer the barley in plenty of water for 25 minutes until tender, then drain.
Whisk the tahini, lemon, garlic and 3 tablespoons of water until smooth. Pile the barley, vegetables and feta into bowls and drizzle with the dressing and parsley.
notes: Contains gluten, dairy and sesame. Use brown rice instead of barley for gluten-free.

recipes.title: Beef Bibimbap-Style Bowls with Gochujang Sauce
recipes.summary: Rice topped with seasoned beef, sauteed vegetables, a fried egg and gochujang sauce.
steps: Cook the rice. Brown the beef with half the soy sauce and the sugar for 6 minutes until cooked through with no pink left.
Stir-fry the carrot and zucchini in the vegetable oil for 3 minutes until just tender, and wilt the spinach with the remaining soy sauce for 1 minute.
Fry the eggs until the whites are set. Mix the gochujang with the sesame oil and 1 tablespoon of water. Build the bowls with rice, beef, vegetables and egg and add the sauce.
notes: Contains soy, sesame and egg.
Food safety: cook the mince to 75°C with no pink, and cook eggs until the whites are set; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Mexican Brown Rice Bowl with Black Beans and Corn Salsa
recipes.summary: A vegetarian bowl of brown rice, spiced beans, charred corn salsa and avocado.
steps: Simmer the rice in plenty of water for 30 minutes until tender, then drain.

Warm the beans with the cumin, paprika and 1/4 cup of water for 8 minutes. Char the corn in a hot pan for 8 minutes until blackened in spots, cut off the kernels and mix with the onion, tomato, lime and coriander.
Build bowls with the rice, beans, salsa, avocado and a spoon of yoghurt.
notes: Contains dairy. Swap the yoghurt for a dairy-free yoghurt if needed.

recipes.title: Spiced Tomato Rice Bowl with Grilled Chicken and Sweet Plantain
recipes.summary: West African-style tomato and pepper rice with spiced grilled chicken thigh and sweet plantain.
steps: Rub the chicken with half the paprika, thyme and a little oil, then grill for 12 minutes, turning, until cooked through at 75°C.

Cook the onion, garlic and capsicum in 1 tablespoon of oil for 6 minutes, add the tomatoes, paste and remaining paprika for 5 minutes, then stir in the rice and stock. Cover and cook gently for 20 minutes until the rice is tender.
Fry the plantain in the remaining oil for 3 minutes each side until golden and serve with the rice and chicken.
notes: Add a chilli for heat.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Persian-Style Barley Bowl with Saffron Chicken and Herbs
recipes.summary: Pearl barley tossed with herbs and pomegranate, topped with saffron yoghurt chicken.
steps: Soak the saffron in 2 tablespoons of hot water for 5 minutes, then stir into the yoghurt with the lemon juice and toss the chicken in it.
Simmer the barley for 25 minutes until tender, then drain. Fry the chicken in the oil for 8 minutes until cooked through.
Toss the barley with the herbs, pomegranate and almonds and serve topped with the chicken.
notes: Contains gluten, dairy and nuts.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Salmon Donburi with Pickled Cucumber
recipes.summary: Glazed salmon over rice with quick pickled cucumber, edamame and sesame.
steps: Cook the rice until tender. Toss the cucumber with the vinegar and a pinch of sugar and leave while you cook the fish.
Sear the salmon in the oil for 4 minutes, skin side down, turn, add the soy sauce, mirin and sugar and cook for 3 minutes until glossy and the fish flakes.
Serve the rice topped with the salmon, glaze, cucumber, edamame and sesame.
notes: Contains fish, soy and sesame.
Food safety: cook salmon until opaque and flaking; keep raw fish below 5°C and eat leftovers within 1 day.

recipes.title: Moroccan Couscous Bowl with Spiced Lamb and Roast Carrots
recipes.summary: Couscous with cumin lamb, roasted carrots, yoghurt and mint.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan) and roast the carrot with half the oil for 25 minutes until caramelised.
Fry the lamb with the spices in the remaining oil for 8 minutes until browned with no pink left. Cover the couscous and raisins with 1.5 cups of boiling water for 5 minutes, then fluff.
Serve the couscous topped with lamb, carrot, yoghurt, mint and lemon.
notes: Contains gluten and dairy.
Food safety: cook the mince to 75°C with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Vermicelli Bowl with Lemongrass Pork
recipes.summary: Rice noodles with grilled lemongrass pork, herbs, pickled carrot and nuoc cham dressing.
steps: Mix the pork with the lemongrass, garlic, 1 tablespoon fish sauce and half the sugar, shape into small patties and grill or pan-fry for 8 minutes until cooked through with no pink.
Soak the noodles in boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse. Stir the lime, 1/4 cup fish sauce, remaining sugar and 1/4 cup of water for the dressing.
Pile the noodles, carrot, cucumber and mint into bowls, top with the pork and peanuts and pour over the dressing.
notes: Contains fish and peanuts.
Food safety: cook pork mince to 75°C with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Spinach and Feta Stuffed Bread Roll
recipes.summary: A rolled and baked pizza dough filled with spinach, feta and mozzarella.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Wilt the spinach with the garlic in the oil for 2 minutes, squeeze out the water and cool.
Roll the dough into a 30cm by 40cm rectangle, top with the spinach, feta, mozzarella and oregano leaving a border, then roll up from the long side and seal the ends.
Brush with egg and bake for 28 minutes until deep golden and cooked through. Rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
notes: Contains gluten, dairy and egg. Serve with a green salad.
Food safety: bake until the dough is cooked through and no longer doughy; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Ham, Cheese and Mushroom Calzone
recipes.summary: Folded pizza pockets stuffed with leg ham, mushroom, mozzarella and ricotta.
steps: Heat the oven to 230°C (210°C fan). Fry the mushroom in the oil for 6 minutes until golden and dry.
Divide the dough into 4, roll into rounds and fill half of each with passata, ham, mushroom, ricotta and mozzarella. Fold over and crimp the edges.
Bake for 18 minutes until puffed and golden, with the cheese melted inside.
notes: Contains gluten and dairy. Use cooked ham, not raw.
Food safety: bake until piping hot in the centre; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Potato and Cheddar Stuffed Flatbreads
recipes.summary: Pan-fried wholemeal flatbreads stuffed with spiced potato and cheddar, served with yoghurt.
steps: Knead the flour, salt and 3/4 cup of water into a soft dough and rest while you mix the mash, spices and cheddar.
Divide the dough into 8, flatten each, fill with the potato mix, seal and roll out gently to 15cm rounds.
Cook each flatbread on a hot pan with a little ghee for 3 minutes each side until golden and cooked through. Serve with yoghurt.
notes: Contains gluten and dairy.

recipes.title: Lamb and Mint Sfiha-Style Open Pies
recipes.summary: Little Lebanese-style open pies with spiced lamb, tomato and pine nuts.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt, oil and 1 cup of warm water, knead for 8 minutes until smooth and rest for 1 hour until doubled.
Mix the lamb, onion, tomato, spices, pine nuts and lemon juice. Heat the oven to 230°C (210°C fan).
Divide the dough into 12 discs, top with the mixture and bake for 15 minutes until the lamb is cooked through with no pink and the base is golden.
notes: Contains gluten and nuts.
Food safety: lamb mince must reach 75°C with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Leek and Chicken Pot Pie with Mustard Cream
recipes.summary: A creamy chicken and leek filling topped with golden puff pastry.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Brown the chicken in the butter for 5 minutes, add the leek for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Add the stock, cream and mustard and simmer for 8 minutes until thick, stir in the peas and tip into a pie dish to cool slightly.
Cover with the pastry, trim, cut a slit, brush with egg and bake for 30 minutes until puffed, golden and bubbling.
notes: Contains gluten, dairy and egg.
Food safety: chicken must be cooked to 75°C with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Mushroom and Lentil Pie with Sweet Potato Top
recipes.summary: A vegan pie of mushroom and lentil gravy under a golden sweet potato mash.
steps: Boil the sweet potato for 15 minutes until soft, drain and mash with the second 2 tbsp of oil.
Soften the onion, carrot and mushroom in the oil for 8 minutes, add the garlic, lentils, paste, stock, soy and thyme and simmer for 30 minutes until the lentils are tender and thick.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Spoon the filling into a dish, top with the mash and bake for 25 minutes until golden at the edges.
notes: Contains soy. Vegan and gluten free.

recipes.title: Spiced Pumpkin and Chickpea Hand Pies
recipes.summary: Flaky folded pies filled with spiced pumpkin, chickpeas and spinach.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Roast the pumpkin with half the oil for 20 minutes until soft.
Soften the onion in the remaining oil for 5 minutes, stir in the curry powder, then the pumpkin, chickpeas, spinach and chutney until the spinach wilts. Cool slightly.
Cut the pastry into 6 large squares, fill, fold, crimp and brush with egg. Bake for 25 minutes until golden.
notes: Contains gluten and egg.

recipes.title: Rosemary Lamb and Vegetable Pie with Sweet Potato Mash
recipes.summary: A lighter shepherd's pie with lamb mince, vegetables and a sweet potato and potato mash.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Boil the potato and sweet potato for 18 minutes until tender, drain and mash with the butter.

Cook the onion, carrot and lamb in the oil for 10 minutes until browned, add the garlic, paste and flour for 1 minute, then the stock and rosemary and simmer for 12 minutes until thick. Stir in the peas.
Spoon into a dish, top with the mash and bake for 25 minutes until golden and bubbling.
notes: Contains gluten and dairy.
Food safety: lamb mince must reach 75°C with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.

recipes.title: Modern Prawn Cocktail Avocados with Marie Rose Sauce
recipes.summary: A 70s dinner-party classic updated with lime, avocado and a lighter yoghurt dressing.
steps: Whisk the mayonnaise, yoghurt, tomato sauce, worcestershire and lemon together.
Fold through the prawns and keep chilled until serving.
Toast the bread until crisp. Fill each avocado half with lettuce and prawn mixture, scatter over the chives and serve with the toast.
notes: Contains shellfish, egg, dairy and gluten. Use only cooked prawns from a reliable source.
Food safety: keep cooked prawns below 5°C and serve within 30 minutes of leaving the fridge; eat leftovers within 1 day.

recipes.title: Oven-Baked Chicken Kievs with Garlic Herb Butter
recipes.summary: A 70s classic baked rather than fried, stuffed with garlic and parsley butter and served with green beans.
steps: Mix the butter, garlic, parsley and zest and chill until firm. Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan).
Cut a deep pocket into each chicken breast, add a quarter of the butter, then coat in flour, egg and the breadcrumbs mixed with the oil.
Bake for 28 minutes until golden and the chicken reaches 75°C in the thickest part. Steam the beans for 4 minutes until tender and serve.
notes: Contains gluten, dairy and egg.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part with no pink and the butter hot; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Salmon en Croute with Spinach and Lemon Cream Cheese
recipes.summary: A show-stopping 80s dinner-party dish: salmon wrapped in puff pastry with spinach and cream cheese.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Wilt the spinach in a dry pan for 2 minutes, squeeze very dry and mix with the cream cheese, zest, dill and salt.
Place the salmon on one sheet of pastry, spread with the filling, cover with the second sheet, seal the edges, trim and brush with egg and sesame seeds.
Bake for 35 minutes until the pastry is deep golden and the fish flakes in the centre.
notes: Contains fish, gluten, dairy, egg and sesame. Cut the fillet into 2 smaller fillets for easier wrapping.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Beef Wellington with Mushroom Duxelles
recipes.summary: The classic dinner-party centrepiece with a simplified duxelles and puff pastry.
steps: Sear the seasoned beef in the oil for 6 minutes all over, brush with mustard and chill. Cook the mushroom, garlic and thyme in a dry pan for 12 minutes until all the moisture has gone.
Lay the ham on cling film, spread the mushroom over, roll the beef in it, chill for 20 minutes, then wrap in the pastry and brush with egg.
Bake at 200°C (180°C fan) for 35 minutes until the pastry is golden and the beef reaches 55 to 60°C for medium. Rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
notes: Contains gluten and egg. Use a probe thermometer; the centre stays pink for medium.

Food safety: whole cuts of beef can be served medium (55 to 60°C) once the outside is fully seared; for children, pregnant women and the elderly, cook to 70°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Cordon Bleu with Lemon and Greens
recipes.summary: Chicken breast stuffed with ham and Swiss cheese, crumbed and baked with a lemon and green bean side.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Slit each chicken breast open, fill with ham and cheese and close with toothpicks.
Coat in flour, egg and the breadcrumbs mixed with the oil, and bake for 30 minutes until golden and the chicken reaches 75°C.
Steam the beans for 4 minutes until tender and serve with the lemon wedges.
notes: Contains gluten, dairy and egg. Remove toothpicks before serving.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Lighter Coq au Vin with Mushrooms and Baby Onions
recipes.summary: A modernised French braise with chicken thigh, mushrooms and less fat, served with mash.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil for 6 minutes each side and set aside. Cook the bacon, onions and mushroom in the pot for 8 minutes until golden, then stir in the garlic and flour for 1 minute.
Add the wine, stock and thyme, return the chicken, cover and simmer for 35 minutes until the chicken is falling off the bone and reaches 75°C.
Boil the potato for 15 minutes until tender, mash with the butter and serve with the coq au vin.
notes: Contains gluten and dairy.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Prawn and Pea Risotto with Lemon and Mint
recipes.summary: Creamy risotto with prawns, peas and a squeeze of lemon, a modern take on a 90s favourite.
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic and rice for 1 minute, then the wine until absorbed.
Add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 20 minutes until the rice is creamy and tender.
Stir in the prawns and peas for 3 minutes until the prawns are pink and cooked, then the butter, parmesan, lemon and mint.
notes: Contains shellfish and dairy.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.
